shot: RO-14 A3 Smashing the piggy bank (motion take, 1920x1080)
intent: Friday night kitchen table. START: a man in a tropical party shirt, grinning, holds a claw hammer raised over a large pink ceramic piggy bank on the table; an open pizza box with a whole pepperoni pizza and three beer bottles beside it. END: the hammer has come down: the piggy bank lies smashed in pink shards with coins spilled across the table; his right hand still grips the hammer, resting on the table among the shards; his left arm is thrown up in a triumphant fist and he laughs.
